messages:
toni: quick heads-up: planning a tiny v2 rollout in the 13:00 UTC change window. plan: global 5% for 20m then hold. need rollback criteria, pinlist changes for known mobile cohort, and a short release note.

ash: +1. mobile SDK v2 clients still at 0.9% using legacy param names. recommend adding them to pinlist and enabling gateway-name-mapping for the window.

ops_maya: alert proposal: if global 5xx > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets OR p95 latency > 700ms -> rollback. tenant quarantine: any tenant >1% errors for 3m -> auto-pin to v1. Also: preflight smoke must pass.

deploybot: scheduled by toni for 2025-10-14T13:00:00Z. action id r-5861230000. will route 5% to v2, run preflight, tag traces with rollout_id=r-5861230000, and capture failed payloads to s3://rollouts/r-5861230000/failed.

rachel: docs: will add a one-paragraph migration note referencing header/param mapping and include the SDK pinlist. PR will be opened before the window.

deploybot: preflight passed. toggle started at 2025-10-14T13:00:00Z -> 5% to v2. monitor r-5861230000.

ops_maya: quick health update after 6m: p50 100ms, p95 185ms, 5xx 0.02% — healthy.

ash: mobile alpha showing intermittent truncated stream when `stream=true`, volume ~0.004%. added mobile cohort to pinlist and enabling gateway-name-mapping.

toni: decision: keep at 5% for remainder of window, do not auto-ramp. rollback CLI below if thresholds hit.

```
# rollback command
 deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --id r-5861230000 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_maya: alerts wired to @eng-oncall and runbook linked. will auto-run rollback on threshold triggers and announce before action.

deploybot: status: partial (5%) active. will not expand without manual approval. final status at 2025-10-14T13:00:22Z.
